caption: The drawing depicts a small, wooden pedestal table with a rectangular top featuring rounded and slightly scalloped edges. The tabletop is a medium brown wood color with visible wood grain. The table has a single, turned central pedestal that extends downward and transitions into three outward-curving legs, each ending in a slight curl. The legs and pedestal are the same medium brown wood color as the tabletop, also displaying the grain. The background is plain and off-white, and the artist's signature appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Candle Stand
